notes.text:
Primary-source partial theorem. Let k be algebraically closed, trivially valued and characteristic zero, X reduced irreducible projective, and omega ample. Put V=(omega^n)>0. BJ's conventions and Sections 7–12 retain possibly nonnormal varieties. Configurations are closed integrally in their prescribed generic fiber; absolute normalization is not substituted. A vertical component E has multiplicity b_E=ord_E(t) and divisorial point v_E=b_E^-1 ord_E. The genuine mixed raw model measure is sum_E b_E product_i((omega_i,model+D_i)|E) delta_vE. Nefness gives nonnegative weights, and the central-fiber cycle gives mass (omega_1...omega_n).

The compactified intersection pairing extends by decreasing model majorants, is finite on mixed E1 tuples, and extends multilinearly to differences. Its pairing with (0,h) defines integration against genuine algebraic PL tests h. Positivity, the mass bound, PL density and Radon representation construct the actual measure. Energy is E(phi)=pairing((omega,phi)^(n+1))/((n+1)V), with E(0)=0 and E(phi+c)=E(phi)+c. E1 consists of genuine global PSH potentials with finite energy. Probability MA is raw MA/V. BJ7.19 gives model agreement, exact mass and integrability; weighted7.21 uses the pairing containing the test minus the pairing containing zero.

Strict-max locality assigns the winning potential's measure on its strict winning locus. Weighted continuity justifies its bounded discontinuous passage. Equal masses give integral_{phi<psi} MA(psi)<=integral_{phi<psi} MA(phi). Mixed intersection negativity gives I>=0 and J comparable to I. BJ10.4, finite-dual-energy divisorial tests and divisorial determination give uniqueness modulo one additive real constant on irreducible X. Global domination10.6 also precedes EP, but applies to genuine global potentials.

For a positive raw Radon target nu, its required mass is V. With mu=nu/V the exact target condition is sup_{psi in E1}(E(psi)-integral psi dmu)<infinity. BJ9.20 equates this with integrability of every E1 potential. A decreasing weighted sum of normalized bounded-J potentials rules out unbounded target integrals; I(t psi,0)<=t[1-(1-t)^n]I(psi,0)<=n t^2 I(psi,0) supplies the scaling estimate. Actual MA targets satisfy the condition by mixed integrability and the tangent energy inequality. No support restriction is imposed.

Under EP, BJ5.11 supplies compactness,8.5 two-sided energy differentiation,9.19 bounded-J target integration continuity, and energy usc variational attainment. Testing both f and -f yields the genuine equation. The raw objective is VE-integral phi dnu; its translation invariance uses exactly mass V. BJ12.8 equates EP, surjectivity and strong completeness. Smooth5.20/12.9 does not establish singular EP. For dimension zero the one-point equation is immediate. The real ample-class global operator is available, but real-class EP is not inferred.

Arbitrary smooth analytic curve maps retain analytic units; common skeleton balancing proves subharmonicity. GR/GJR and GM detect represented nefness, BE7.8 supplies FS approximation over a finite Laurent field, and an exact global-section coefficient cutoff descends it to trivial k. BE5.16/5.17 avoid requiring an auxiliary model's generic class to descend. The constructions require rational local slopes/constants and an actually glued metric; they do not establish singular EP.
notes.text:
Independent proof drafts. The corrected local rational class consists of continuous finite selections of rational affine formulas in regular log norms, each formula finite on its stated neighborhood. Infinite coordinates have zero coefficients. Contact minorants satisfy f(t')>=ell(t')+C with equality at t, retaining the same constant in both assertions.

Over a finite Laurent field K, published Ducros3.2 and valued-field image1.2 give finite rational polyhedral images for finitely many units on compact strict domains, with dimension at most the analytic dimension. Refine by every branch-equality hyperplane. Different affine values remain separated on each connected relative cell, so continuity fixes the selected value there and on its closure. Closure preimages are strict Laurent domains after clearing rational slopes/constants into monomials and parameter powers. Their finite closed cover is admissible: near a point discard domains not containing it. This proves actual strict-G Q-PL membership. The stronger printed CLD dimension equality is unnecessary and fails for constant moments.

For every smooth analytic curve map over Omega=completion of an algebraic closure of K, local algebraicity concerns the source curve only: coordinate pullbacks remain analytic units. Thuillier2.2.24/2.3.20 factor their logs through one finite semistable skeleton and give harmonic balancing. Finite affine selections are lisse after subdividing at finitely many intersections, including real breakpoints. Subtract the harmonic contact support; each outgoing derivative of the difference is nonnegative and the harmonic weighted sum is zero. Thus the Laplacian is nonnegative. Zero and identically-zero coordinates are discarded, type I/IV unit-log germs are locally constant, and affinoid boundary slopes are not tested. Thuillier3.4.4 gives subharmonicity. Wanner Section4 is used only after smooth proper compactification, on the original open.

For an actually glued continuous metric on an ample rational bundle over singular projective X, strict branch covers give norm-one frames and actual transition cocycles. GM2.10 constructs the formal metric on that same bundle. GR5.1/5.4 detect residue nefness through every smooth analytic curve map; GJR7.1/7.6 and GM3.11 give local-to-global represented nefness. GM Lemma3.3 detects nefness back on an already represented K-model. Proper formal/algebraic representation and projective domination retain the generic fiber. BE1805.01016v3 Theorem7.8 then gives uniform FS approximation, with general-variety scope and no smoothness hypothesis. This avoids BJ's smooth-only4.19. No general R-PL positive-current pullback/converse is assumed; GR Remark1.8's warning is retained.

Exact Gauss descent uses an independent variable T of radius exp(-1/q). H0 base change gives s_j=sum_r varpi^r f_jr for generating sections on mB_K. Canonical trivial-reference norms of k-sections are at most one by proper centers. The Gauss value is (1/m)max_{j,r}(log||f_jr||+lambda_j-r/q). Its continuous finite value on compact X has a lower bound b, so all sufficiently large r terms fall uniformly below b and can be removed exactly. Retained sections globally generate; otherwise a closed k-point of their base locus would force minus infinity. Uniform errors and decreasing limits are preserved. No Laurent expansion over Omega is used.

For any rational model function F_K on O_XK, BE5.14/5.16(vi), including proofs LF1989–2033, express it as an exact pure FS difference psi-psi' by twisting with any sufficiently ample model bundle. Their common generic class M may not descend. Choose fixed ample H/k and a large a with aH_K-M ample. BE5.17, LF2036–2043, adds a cancelling pure FS metric tau on this class; product sections put both final expressions on aH_K. Apply the exact Gauss cutoff only to those final sections. Their difference is actual BJ rational algebraic PL. Neither equivariance nor a descending generic class for the auxiliary model is needed, and an FS difference is not asserted positive.

For rational local f near compact C inside U, construct compact rational-domain neighborhoods W with C inside int W and W inside U. Actual strict membership makes its pullback a formal trivial-bundle metric. GM2.7 extends that represented metric globally. Algebraize and apply exact model-function descent to obtain global BJ PL agreement near C, not necessarily on all U.

The collar construction stays on the original nonnormal X. Start with an ample standard open D(s); invert only constrained functions nonzero at the point. Section localization gives f_i=tau_i/s^d_i, and a=s product_i tau_i cuts out exactly the localized D(a). Clear all constraints by one power a^m and add a complete very ample system whose ratios generate its affine algebra. Rational bounds and a negative floor give compact Q={v<=0} inside U and P={v<=-epsilon} inside int Q. All tensor factors and constraint thresholds are retained. BJ rational PL density then gives clipped functions chi_i supported inside a finite cover and equal to one on compact shrinkings. Successive rho_i=min(chi_i,1-sum_{j<i}rho_j) form a nonnegative subordinate PL partition summing to one, without a variable denominator.

notes.text:
Unverified bounded-local proof draft for common-neighborhood decreasing limits of corrected contact rational selections. It does not identify every weak input with this class. Choose one ample collar Q={v<=0}, P={v<=-epsilon}, bound M, theta=omega+ddc p, and rational A with A epsilon>2M+1. Put h=Av+M+1. On P, h<-M; on the compact boundary strip it exceeds M+1/2. Nested closed sets {u_ij>=h} have empty intersection, so an entire tail has the strict boundary inequality, without Dini for a discontinuous limit. Define Psi_ij=max(u_ij-h,0) on Q and zero outside. Its metric weight is max(u_ij-M-1,Av), with a whole reference collar; n2 proves genuine global membership.

Set Phi_i=Psi_i/A+p and G=v-p+(M+1)/A. On P, u_i/A=Phi_i+G and ddc G=omega, hence ddc u_i=A(omega+ddc Phi_i). Define the local mixed measure as A^n times this genuine global mixed measure on int P. Continuous model compatibility retains actual residual degrees, multiplicities and defects. Explicit limiting truncations give approximation independence. A third collar inside two inner domains compares restricted sequences and proves overlap independence.

For bounded tests, u_0j=A Phi_0j+AG. BJ7.21 treats the first term and compact cutoffs treat fixed continuous G. Signed PL factors are differences of genuine same-class FS metrics. Exact local extensions and global pairing symmetry give compact IBP; weighted limits extend it to bounded local inputs. CLD8.7.2 is used only for locally uniform continuous convergence. For a bounded globally locally L-psh phi, write T=omega+ddc phi, T0=omega and S=sum_j T^j T0^(n-1-j). With n2's subordinate PL partition, compact IBP gives integral rho_i(T^n-T0^n)=integral phi ddc rho_i S. Supports remain in their charts and all weighted integrals are finite. Summing gives ddc(sum rho_i)S=ddc1 S=0, so raw mass is exactly V. Common collars transfer winning-locus locality, comparison and independent divisorial order determination. Dimension zero is separate.

BJ2.12/2.33 give an ample model realizing every source-convention divisorial point with positive actual weight b_E(L_model|E)^n. This supplies a bounded genuine test b without EP or a Dirac equation. Translate b below phi and put phi_t=(1-t)phi+t b. Under phi<=psi MA(psi)-a.e., comparison and equal mass give full MA(phi_t) mass to {phi_t<psi}; mixed positivity supplies an atom there. Let rational t decrease to zero and use divisorial determination. Known smooth EP then gives smooth local/global equality through decreasing continuous-majorant nets and genuine envelope contact orthogonality. Continuous genuine envelope metrics belong to the rational local decreasing class by uniform FS approximation, rational rounding and error shifts. No metrizability is assumed.

An actual affine FS reference b has an explicit projective compactification after rational slope clearing and adding original affine generators at dominated low weights. A continuous contact rational v equal to b outside compact K defines the same metric near the boundary. n2 gives genuine CPSH and uniform FS approximation. Taking high very ample systems and adding low constant/generator branches converts these to actual affine FS functions; a basepoint-free system alone is not assumed to embed the affine chart. Uniform error remains uniform on the whole noncompact chart.

For Rossi's relatively compact analytic neighborhood V, finite separating polynomials and generator bounds give a compact polytope containing the hull and avoiding the bad boundary set. Its affine FS exhaustion u vanishes on the polytope and is positive on that set. An integer C makes Cu>log|f|-t on the whole boundary, giving a whole winning collar. The function Cu outside V and max(Cu,log|f|-t) inside is a continuous compact perturbation, including at zeros of f. An affine FS approximant with error below one third of its positive value at the hull point contradicts polynomial-hull membership. This proves this continuous Rossi application without weak affine regularization.

For an already supplied affine FS sequence u_j decreasing to u<=g, choose negative C_r and increasing R_r>2-C_r. Compact closed-set emptiness gives increasing j_r with u_jr<g+1 on Q_r={g<=R_r}. The genuine collar potentials max(u_jr-2g,C_r) on Q_r, constant outside, decrease on old sublevels and on new annuli because u_jr-2g<1-g<C_(r-1). Uniform FS errors epsilon_r=4^-r and shifts 2 sum_{i>=r}epsilon_i give decreasing actual affine approximants w_r<=2g+sup H_1. This checks annular monotonicity instead of assuming a diagonal is decreasing.

For already regularizable v on Y_f with v<=g, the actual exhaustion g_c=max(g,-(c/3)log|f|) includes f^-1 among generators. Controlled approximants satisfy w_i+c log|f|<=max(2g+c log|f|,(c/3)log|f|)+B. Floors yield continuous contact rational functions on Y, constant near Z(f), decreasing and bounded by one exhaustion h. Single-function moving collars make psi_i=b_i-2h genuine; psi_i<=-h gives a whole constant boundary collar for max(psi_i,-i). Uniform approximation and summable shifts give an actual affine FS sequence for the damped function. This proves an already-regularizable implication, not weak-input identification.
